scope: ICM2026 Section 9 first three published chapters; local integration only

reports.speaker: Misha Bialy and Andrey E. Mironov

mathematical_review.parent_scope: Read all 142 new knowledge pages and the three narratives; checked stated assumptions, proof steps, prerequisite reuse and distinctions among definitions, local proofs, cited theorems and open questions.

independent_berger.correction: Ergodicity is sufficient, not necessary, for constant Lyapunov data.

mathematical_review.boundaries: The review and finite calculation tests do not reproduce every cited research proof. Each source packet records the exact reading scope and the local versus cited proof scope.

site_check.scope: all trees, not only research notes
site_check.semanticLimit: The register records editorial review; structural checks do not prove mathematical correctness or semantic atomicity.

visual_review.scope: Viewport screenshots of the subject landing page and all three narratives, desktop and mobile. The final pass changes only prerequisite links; the automated browser pass covers every new page at both widths.

preserved_unrelated_changes: Pre-existing theme/tree.xsl modifications and unrelated untracked projects were not reverted, staged or published.
